errors.generic: Couldn't complete the request. Please try again.
errors.channelNotConfigured: This delivery channel isn't configured. Contact an administrator.
errors.providerNotConfigured: The SMS provider isn't configured correctly. Contact an administrator.
errors.smsTooLong: The guest name, wedding title, and RSVP link exceed the three-part SMS limit. Check these details.
errors.smsRecipientDetailsTooLong: At least one guest's name, wedding details, and RSVP link exceed the three-part SMS limit.
errors.smsCopyBudgetTooSmall: The selected guests' details use nearly all available SMS space. Shorten the wedding title or select fewer guests, then generate again.
errors.smsCopyRequiresEdit: Shorten the SMS invitation before sending. Each guest's personal RSVP link will remain intact.
errors.smsAiInvalidOutput: AI couldn't create usable SMS copy. Your previous draft is preserved; try again or edit it manually.
errors.smsAiTooLong: AI couldn't create usable SMS invitation copy. Your previous draft is preserved; try again or edit the copy.
errors.invalidInvitationLink: The guest's invitation link is invalid. Reload guest data before previewing or sending.
errors.conflict: The data changed elsewhere. Load the latest version and confirm before overwriting.
errors.invalidRequest: The server rejected the content or recipient list. Check plain-text content, contact details, the 5,000-recipient limit, and SMS length.
errors.notFound: Required data could not be found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.draftNotFound: The invitation draft is missing on the server. Reload the page; if it is still missing, create or save content before sending.
errors.guestNotFound: The guest list has changed. Reload it, review the list, and select your recipients again.
errors.weddingNotFound: The wedding could not be found, or you no longer have access to it.
errors.batchNotFound: This send batch could not be found. Reload the send history.
errors.noRecipients: This group has no active guests. Reload the list and choose other recipients.
